text:
Maya: uploaded two layout options — compact ledger vs expando rows for the billing panel. want quick gut checks before design review tomorrow. compact = denser, expando = more discoverable invoice actions.
Sam: can you drop the figma link?
Maya: https://www.figma.com/file/EXAMPLE/billing-panel-v2 — check both pages: compact-ledger + expando-rows
James: first impression: compact is great for scanning monthly totals but hides download/pay actions. expando makes the CTA visible but increases vertical height.
Aria: accessibility flag: the scope pills in compact mode are < 4.5:1 contrast in dark theme. also token denom "k" is not read well by voiceover.
Oliver: keyboard nav problem in prototype — the expand chevron is small and not a distinct focus target. if the row is focusable and Enter toggles, that feels more reliable.
Maya: Agree on keyboard. also debating where to surface the wallet/pay CTA — inline on each invoice row vs a global header action. concerns: accidental pay vs discoverability.
Sam: idea: keep pay action in overflow menu by default, surface a small inline "Pay»" only for overdue invoices. reduces noise but keeps action local.
James: we could add a tiny sparkline to compact rows to preserve trend context. that helps scanning without expanding.
Aria: if we add sparklines, include aria-labels: e.g. aria-label="Usage trend last 30 days, rising" and role="img" plus short desc. also change pill label from "Tokens" -> "Token amount" for clarity to screen readers.
deploy-bot: Maya uploaded updated mocks (compact-ledger-v2, expando-rows-v1)
Maya: pushed a11y fixes: increased pill contrast, updated pill copy, made rows keyboard-focusable, added optional sparkline. Also prototyped the overdue-pay inline CTA.
Oliver: LGTM with those fixes. one nit: the row expand animation is slow on mobile — consider reducing to 120ms.
Sam: I'll set up a short internal AB: route 50% users to compact+sparkline, 50% to expando with inline overdue-pay. we'll track "download click", "pay click", and average rows expanded per session.
Maya: perfect. added to tomorrow's agenda (10m). if anyone has other blocking a11y issues ping me now. :thumbsup:
